base_feature_storage: source features unchanged; country categorical; continuous factors float32; ordinal and transformed values uint8 with a separate missing sentinel
sampling_order: original parquet order: train followed by validation
transform_history: all train and validation dates, including test rows; one ticker at a time; current date included
warmup: 52 calendar weeks since first nonmissing feature value and 52 nonmissing trailing observations; mean13 also requires13 observations
binning: per-date full-universe average-tie percentile ranks, ceil(rank*5)-1, NaNs preserved
